items.title: Zoho-React Integration Portal
items.description: Enterprise portal seamless bridging Zoho Creator data with a high-performance React frontend.
items.longDescription: A custom ERP solution designed to overcome the UI limitations of standard low-code platforms. This portal fetches data from Zoho Creator via REST APIs and presents it in a highly interactive, custom-styled React dashboard. It features real-time synchronization, custom workflows, and a role-based access control system.
features: Real-time bi-directional data sync with Zoho Creator
Custom Data Grid with filtering, sorting, and export
Automated PDF generation and reporting workflows

items.title: Enterprise Task Master
items.description: Advanced project management tool with Kanban boards and Gantt charts.
items.longDescription: A sophisticated project management application built for large teams. It features a high-performance drag-and-drop Kanban board, interactive Gantt timelines for resource planning, and real-time collaboration using WebSockets. Optimized for rendering thousands of tasks without performance lag.

items.title: FinTech Analytics Suite
items.description: Real-time financial data visualization dashboard with massive data handling.
items.longDescription: A high-frequency trading dashboard designed for financial analysts. It processes and visualizes massive streams of stock and crypto data in real-time. Leverages Web Workers for data processing to keep the UI thread unblocked and smooth.
features: Dark mode optimized for multiple screens

items.title: Creator Low-Code Enhancer
items.description: A suite of custom widgets and scripts enhancing Zoho Creator applications.
items.longDescription: A collection of custom-built widgets (React-based) embedded within Zoho Creator to provide functionality not natively available. Includes custom calendar views, inventory scanners, and interactive maps.
features: Custom Deluge Scripts for complex logic
